title: The Void That Thinks Backwards

features.name: reversed mirror
features.desc-on-touch: You see your thought reflected from its end, traveling back to where it began. Which is which?

features.name: palindrome pool
features.desc-on-touch: The water reads the same forwards and backwards. You dip your finger in and the time runs both ways.

features.name: thought-curve
features.desc-on-touch: A shape that ends where it should have begun. It is trying to remember its own start.

inscription: here, thought learns that backwards is also forwards, and the two were never different

file.name: Palimpsest_ReverseIndex_1970s_Fragmentary.txt
file.note: A document that reorganizes itself: the ending is now the beginning, but the text remains readable
